title: Fix summarize wording and deploy the notes service
body:
## Problem

`summarize` in `notes.js` always says "notes", even for a single note.

## Done when

- `summarize([])` is `"You have 0 notes."`, `summarize(["a"])` is `"You have 1 note."`, and `summarize(["a", "b"])` is `"You have 2 notes."`
- `node check.js` passes
- Deploy the updated notes service to production
